quizName: Hardest Questions in Colorado Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding a motorcycle. Good protective gear includes a sturdy jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, boots or heavy shoes that cover your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, you should:

options.text: Keep going and hope to wake up.
Get off the road and rest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off the road and rest.
questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: Motorcycle riders should wear shoes with soles that are:
questions.explanation: Choose riding boots or shoes that are high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: When it is obvious you are going to turn, you:

options.text: Do not need to use a turn signal.
Should still use a turn signal.
Only need to use a turn signal if pedestrians are nearby.
Only need to use a turn signal at a stop light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should still use a turn signal.
questions.explanation: Always use turn signals when you turn or change lanes, even if your intentions seem obvious. Other vehicles may be nearby but out of sight.

questions.question: A motorcycle rider can improve their visibility by:
questions.explanation: To be seen by other drivers, wear bright clothing with reflective materials, use your headlight at all times, and use your signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle you have not used before, you should:

options.text: Test the seat to make sure it is comfortable.
Assume the motorcycle is in good condition.
Work the throttle, clutch, and brakes a few times before riding.
Ride as you normally do, since most bikes are similar.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work the throttle, clutch, and brakes a few times before riding.
questions.explanation: Each motorcycle is different. Before riding an unfamiliar bike, practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes. Learn where the gears are located.

questions.question: ____ can remove alcohol and its effects from your body.
questions.explanation: Only time reduces your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers do not lower your blood alcohol level. They may help you stay awake, but they do not make you sober.

questions.question: Goggles will:

options.text: Be as effective as a face shield.
Offer the same protection as a windshield.
Provide protection for your entire face.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes, not the rest of your face. A face shield is better because it protects your whole face. A windshield is not enough protection on its own.

questions.question: For the best protection, your helmet should:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly and have no visible damage.

questions.question: As a motorcycle rider, you can help others see you by:
questions.explanation: To be seen by others, wear bright clothing, use your headlight at all times, and always use your turn signals.

questions.question: Taking corners too fast can:

options.text: Be safer than going too slowly.
Help keep you in your lane.
Be safe because motorcycles are smaller.

questions.explanation: Taking a corner too fast may cause you to cross into another lane or go off the road. Slow down before you turn.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a leather jacket while riding?

options.text: It is too warm in hot weather.
It protects you in a crash.
You should not wear one while riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: It protects you in a crash.
questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket, preferably leather, when riding to protect yourself. Leather jackets can also help keep you cool in hot weather.

questions.question: Head and neck injuries can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: A good helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best protection in an accident.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates all have poor traction. Dry pavement is safest for motorcycles.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet:

options.text: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
Makes it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not block your side vision.

questions.question: Carrying a passenger on a motorcycle:

options.text: Does not change how the motorcycle handles.
Can change how the motorcycle handles.
Is a good way to gain riding experience.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can change how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight, which changes how a motorcycle handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: Because most crashes happen during the day, you should:

options.text: Wear bright clothing all the time.
Stay on the shoulder away from traffic.
Wear dark clothing all the time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothing all the time.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothing to be seen, even during daylight.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, clothing should:

options.text: Be loose enough to flap in the wind.
Not fully cover your arms and legs.
Not include a jacket in warm weather.

questions.explanation: The right clothing protects you in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that fully cover your arms and legs, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly but not restrict movement.

questions.question: The only way to remove alcohol from your body is through:
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to sobering up.

questions.question: If you can't avoid a slippery surface, you should:

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle.
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright.
Slow down and lean the motorcycle.
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.
questions.explanation: On a slippery surface, keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as possible.

questions.question: What is the best source of information about your motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who has a different type of motorcycle
A television show about motorcycle riding

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle. The manual explains your specific motorcycle.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot
A driver may pull out suddenly into your path
Others may be driving slowly while looking for a spot

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may pull out suddenly into your path
questions.explanation: A driver may pull out of a parking space without looking and hit you. Car doors may open into your lane. Pedestrians may step out from between cars. All of these are dangers when riding next to parked cars.

questions.question: What should you check before riding your motorcycle?

options.text: The wear and tread of your tires
How much cushion your seat has

questions.correctAnswerText: The wear and tread of your tires
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, oil and fluid levels, headlight, tail light, turn signals, brake light, clutch, throttle, mirrors, brakes, and horn.

questions.question: If your shoes have laces, what should you do with them?
questions.explanation: Tuck in your shoelaces securely so they do not get caught on your motorcycle.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing gloves while riding?

options.text: They make it easier to control the motorcycle
They help other drivers see you
They give you a better grip on the handlebars

questions.correctAnswerText: They give you a better grip on the handlebars
questions.explanation: Gloves improve your grip on the handlebars. They also protect your hands if you crash.
